newsitem.title: UK: Bourne End buys properties from Burford.
newsitem.headline: Bourne End buys properties from Burford.

text.p: Britain's Bourne End Properties Plc (BEP) said on Tuesday it had agreed to purchase a retail portfolio from property investment group Burford Holdings Plc for 30.35 million stg.
The acquisition will be satisfied by 26 million stg in cash, 6.3 million shares in BEP at 42 pence a share and a further 1.7 million stg in cash deferred for 12 months.

The portfolio consists of: the 300,000 sq ft Victoria Plaza shopping centre in Southend; the 81,500 sq ft Prescott Centre shopping complex in Merseyside; two units on the Whitley Road retail park near Newcastle; and 19 retail units in Gloucester.
The four freehold properties currently produce annual rental income of 2.79 million stg, BEP said in a statement.
